about: Transmitter retag applied by scripts/retag_te_valves.py --mapping data/te_retag_2026-10-29.json on 2026-10-29 (journal entry 61). Every TE measurement is a field transmitter feeding the DCS, so its field tag takes T as the second letter (ISA-5.1): FI-101 becomes FT-101, read by FIC-101. Revision C drew them with indicator letters, which a controls reader takes for local gauges. Controllers, valves and the analyzer component suffixes keep their tags. Tags before this date appear in the journal and in dated results; revisions A and C are archived with them.
model_tag_convention: ISA-5.1 letters + loop number. TE publishes XMEAS/XMV indices, not plant tags, so tag numbers are ASSIGNED by this project and the original index is kept as xmeas/xmv. Measurements are field transmitters (FT, PT, LT, TT, AT, JT) numbered 101-137 in XMEAS order; each control valve carries the loop number of the measurement its controller reads (data/te_control_loops.json). A renamed item keeps its previous tag as former_tag: valves renumbered 2026-10-28, transmitters retagged from indicator letters (FI, PI, ...) 2026-10-29. Controllers are listed under controllers.
